description: Schedule something the Nock Agent does on its own, every week or every day ("toda segunda, ache 50 decisores novos e coloque na campanha X"), Brasília time. Actions: campaign_add_people (find count new people for a campaign from its search or signal), campaign_refill_from_signal (run the campaign's signal and add count people), campaign_status (pause or resume a campaign), sheet_enrichment (run an enrichment column on the rows that do not have it yet). Each run spends at most creditCap credits, doing fewer people or rows to fit; an empty creditCap means the full price of one run. What a run does depends on the workspace's autonomy level for that action: 1 only tells, 2 (default) suggests with a one-tap approval, 3 does it and tells after. Creating spends nothing. The campaign or sheet is the one passed; none is picked automatically. The result says what will run, when, and the cap.

campaignId.description: Exact campaign UUID, for the campaign actions.

columnId.description: Enrichment column id (as the sheet's rows list it), for sheet_enrichment.

count.description: People per run (1 to 50), for campaign_add_people and campaign_refill_from_signal.

creditCap.description: Most credits one run may spend. Empty: the full price of one run.

hour.description: Hour of the day, Brasília time (0 to 23).

name.description: Short name in the user's language. Empty: one is written from the schedule.

status.description: For campaign_status: paused to pause, active to resume.

weekday.description: The day it runs, or every_day.

name: create_routine
title: Criar rotina do Nock Agent
